title: Social Media Agency in Houston
metaTitle: Social Media Marketing Agency in Houston, TX | TDM
metaDescription: Social media management for Houston businesses: strategy, content calendars, community replies and paid social for restaurants, clinics and B2B firms.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) manages social media for Houston businesses remotely: strategy, monthly content calendars, design and editing, publishing, replies to comments and messages, and paid social. Houston asks for two distinct approaches. A restaurant in Montrose or a boutique in Rice Village lives on Instagram and TikTok. An engineering or equipment company on the west side needs LinkedIn content that the right job titles will read.

sections.heading: What Houston audiences respond to
paragraphs: This is a city that talks about food constantly. Barbecue, Tex-Mex, crawfish in spring, new openings in the Heights and EaDo: people decide where to eat from short videos and from what friends share. For restaurants, bars and food brands, the feed is the menu. Replies to comments and direct messages need to be quick because many of them are booking questions.

Local pride is strong and tied to the calendar. Rodeo season changes what people wear, eat and do for weeks. Astros, Rockets and Texans game days fill bars and shift foot traffic. Businesses that plan content around these moments, without forcing a connection that is not there, tend to see their best engagement of the year.

Then there is the weather. During a storm or a flood warning, customers check social accounts first to see whether a business is open. A timely post about hours or service status matters more than the planned calendar, which we pause when needed.

sections.heading: Social media for energy and industrial companies
paragraphs: A large share of Houston companies sell to other companies, and their buyers are on LinkedIn. Useful content here is practical: a project completed, a piece of equipment explained, a safety milestone, a new certification, people from the team who do the work. It should read as if an engineer approved it. Recruitment is often the second goal, since skilled technicians and engineers look at a company's page before applying.

Large industry conferences in the city bring buyers and partners to town each year. We plan posts before, during and after an event so that a booth or a talk produces more than a stack of business cards.

sections.heading: What the service includes
paragraphs: We begin with a short discovery of the brand, the audience and what the accounts have done so far. You approve each monthly calendar before anything is published.
bullets: Channel strategy: which platforms are worth your time and which are not.
Content creation: graphics, captions and video editing by our in-house media team, using footage and photos you supply from your location.
Scheduling and publishing on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn and other channels as agreed.
Community management: comments, messages and reviews answered in your brand's voice.
Paid social on Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn to put proven posts in front of more of the right people.
Monthly reporting on reach, engagement, traffic and, where ads run, cost per result.

sections.heading: Choosing a social media agency
paragraphs: Ask where the raw material will come from. We work remotely, so photos and clips from your kitchen, shop floor or job sites are supplied by your team, and we give clear guidance on what to capture. Ask who replies to messages and how fast. Ask what will be reported each month, and make sure it includes something that connects to enquiries or sales.

presence: TDM runs social media for Houston businesses remotely. We do not have an office or a crew in the city. Planning, design, editing, publishing and replies are handled online by our team, using the photos and footage your staff provide.

faqs.q: Which social media platforms matter most for a Houston business?
faqs.a: It depends on who buys from you. Restaurants, retail and beauty do most of their business through Instagram, TikTok and Facebook. Companies selling to the energy, industrial or medical sectors usually get more from LinkedIn. We recommend a mix after looking at your customers, not a fixed package.

faqs.q: Is LinkedIn worth it for an oil and gas service company?
faqs.a: Usually, yes. Buyers, engineers and potential hires check a supplier's page and its people. Consistent, factual posts about projects and capabilities keep the company in mind during long buying cycles.

faqs.q: Can you manage our social media without being in Houston?
faqs.a: Yes. Strategy, design, editing, publishing and community replies are all done online. What we need from you is raw photos and clips from your location, and we provide a simple shot list each month to make that easy.

faqs.q: How much does social media management cost in Houston?
faqs.a: It depends on the number of channels, how much content is produced each month and whether paid social is included. We quote after a free consultation.

faqs.q: How long before we see results from social media?
faqs.a: It depends on where the accounts start and what you want them to achieve. We agree the measures and a realistic timeframe in the plan.
